senses.definition: vb. make light of, toss aside (cf. Assyrian salû, throw off, shake off (yoke) Dl500; Arabic سلو, سَلَا is be forgetful, neglectful Lane1417 Aramaic סְלָא despise, ܣܠܴܐ reject);—
Pf. 2 ms. סָלִיתָ ψ 119:118 thou dost make light of all those that err from thy statutes.—Cf. also סַלּוֹן infr.
intens. Pf. 3 ms. סִלָּה La 1:15 Adonay hath flouted at my mighty ones.
